#### 1. immunodeficiency 14b, autosomal recessive  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.782)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:8977)

**Proposed mechanism:** PIK3CD (HGNC:8977) —DISRUPTS→ PI3K-Akt signaling pathway (R-HSA-8963684); PI3K-Akt signaling pathway (R-HSA-8963684) —LEADS_TO→ Recurrent respiratory infections (HP:0002090); PI3K-Akt signaling pathway (R-HSA-8963684) —LEADS_TO→ Recurrent infections (HP:00114210). Loss-of-function mutations in PIK3CD disrupt the PI3K-Akt signaling pathway, leading to impaired immune cell function and increased susceptibility to recurrent infections, manifesting as a shared phenotype.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in PIK3CD with a gain-of-function mechanism in either disease would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: rs743240797)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of PIK3CD in both diseases could lead to the development of targeted therapies aimed at restoring PI3K-Akt pathway function for improved immune responses.
